scientific_integrity: The proof establishes all dimensions and arbitrary-field cases. Small finite-field exhaustive tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem. No external independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only embedded subalgebras of a single unweighted cyclic permutation evolution algebra. The dimension-one idempotent count and general disjoint-support natural-basis theorem are already known and are not claimed as new. The full text of a relevant early permutation-algebra article could not be examined; equivalent antecedents remain possible.
title: The divisor-and-root lattice of subalgebras of cyclic permutation evolution algebras
